security_audit.summary: Most static matches are false positives caused by JavaScript regular-expression APIs, template literals, documentation-relative paths, and local media workflow operations. Two material risks remain: the workflow silently updates remote skill code and automatically uses available third-party vision credentials to process captured content without an explicit consent checkpoint. Static review was capped at 400/688 representative findings; omitted static matches are unconfirmed, so automatic publishing stays disabled until manual review.

remediation.suggestion: Manually review the omitted 288 static analyzer matches or reduce bundled generated/vendor/reference content before enabling automatic publication.

remediation.issue: The skill silently runs a remote npx update before use.
remediation.suggestion: Remove automatic updates from the workflow. Present the version and request explicit user approval before downloading or executing updated skill content.

remediation.issue: Existing third-party vision keys trigger automatic asset-description processing.
remediation.suggestion: Require an explicit opt-in that names the provider and explains what captured content will be sent before invoking caption extraction.

remediation.issue: Media commands rely on local and sibling-skill paths.
remediation.suggestion: Validate resolved paths remain within approved project or installed-skill directories before reading, writing, or spawning tools.

content.value_statement: Product launches need a clear story, consistent visuals, and an organized production process. This skill guides HyperFrames projects from source capture through review and final rendering.
actual_capabilities: Creates a HyperFrames project from a confirmed product brief.
Captures a product URL and prepares brand assets for a video project.
Builds a branded frame specification from a shipped frame preset.
Drafts a storyboard, narration script, visual direction, and frame plan.
Generates project audio metadata, captions, transitions, and an assembled index.
Runs HyperFrames checks and renders an approved MP4.
limitations: Requires the HyperFrames CLI and its dependent skills to be installed.
Voice, music, and asset availability depend on configured providers and sign-in status.
Final rendering requires user approval after the review checkpoint.
The skill does not guarantee that a captured website has usable brand assets.

use_cases.title: Launch a SaaS feature
use_cases.description: Turn a feature brief and product URL into a paced promotional video.

use_cases.title: Create a product demo
use_cases.description: Use captured screens and a narration script to build a structured product showcase.

use_cases.title: Prepare a campaign video
use_cases.description: Create a branded launch asset with captions, music, and final review gates.

prompt_templates.title: Start from a URL
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 30-second product launch video from https://example.com. Use a clear, confident tone.

prompt_templates.title: Use a launch brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a product launch video for our analytics dashboard. Emphasize faster reporting, use a modern visual style, and include captions.

prompt_templates.title: Build from a script
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this approved script to create a 45-second launch video. Keep the narration verbatim and use our captured product screens as the primary visuals.

prompt_templates.title: Produce a reviewed deliverable
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 60-second vertical launch video for our mobile app. Draft the storyboard first, wait for my approval, then render a high-quality MP4.

output_examples.input: Create a launch video for a new team analytics feature.
output: A confirmed project brief and captured product assets.
A storyboard with narration, visual direction, and frame timing.
A reviewed MP4 path with a contact sheet for revisions.

output_examples.input: Turn this product script into a short promotional video.
output: A verbatim or restructured narration plan based on the brief.
Branded frames, captions, transitions, and an assembled video project.

best_practices: Provide a confirmed product brief with audience, format, duration, and desired tone.
Review the storyboard and sketches before authorizing final rendering.
Use official brand assets and verify that captured text and claims are accurate.
anti_patterns: Do not render before reviewing the storyboard and visual preview.
Do not assume voice or music providers are available without checking sign-in status.
Do not use unverified marketing claims in narration or on-screen text.

faq.question: What input can I provide?
faq.answer: Provide a product URL, a marketing brief, or a pasted narration script.

faq.question: Does it support vertical video?
faq.answer: Yes. The project format can be landscape, portrait, or square.

faq.question: Can I use my own script?
faq.answer: Yes. The brief can specify verbatim or restructured narration.

faq.question: Does it create captions?
faq.answer: Yes, when audio timings and a supported caption configuration are available.

faq.question: Is sign-in required?
faq.answer: Sign-in may be needed for HeyGen voice and music services. Local engines can be used when available.

faq.question: When does rendering happen?
faq.answer: The workflow renders only after checks pass and the user approves the final review.
